evidence_classification.qualification: This frozen record attests that a structured public challenge contract is included in the PROJECT ACCORD public-surface artifact. Under the public claim contract, R1 means structured public challengeability and does not imply public execution access to, simulation of, public trace generation from, or independent reproduction of the private reference implementation. External empirical generation of private-reference traces is not currently claimed. The underlying reference implementation and detailed CI evidence remain private. This sanitized record is a project attestation, not independent public reproduction.

ci_summary.qualification: The listed profiles are deliberately disclosed project-attested examples, not an exhaustive inventory of private or public CI coverage. Provider-specific run identifiers, job identifiers, runner labels, timestamps, exact runtime patch versions, repository identifiers, and raw logs are intentionally withheld.
